Anything with a `null` is an open question for Wesleigh (see the plan checklist). This is Wesleigh's home address and he confirmed publishing it; it is already public on the GBP. If that ever changes, switch the GBP to a service-area business FIRST, then shorten `display` and null out `street` here.
